options.description: The font families to use. Can be repeated for fallback fonts. Use 'ghostty +list-fonts' to see available fonts.
The font family for bold text. Falls back to font-family if not set.
The font family for italic text. Falls back to font-family if not set.
The font family for bold italic text. Falls back to font-family if not set.
The named font style to use for regular text, based on the style string advertised by the font.
The named font style for bold text. Set to 'false' to disable bold style entirely.
The named font style for italic text. Set to 'false' to disable italic style entirely.
The named font style for bold italic text. Set to 'false' to disable bold italic style entirely.
Control whether Ghostty synthesizes bold/italic styles when not available. Use 'no-bold', 'no-italic', 'no-bold-italic' to disable specific styles.
Apply a font feature setting. Supports OpenType feature tags like 'calt', '-liga', '+dlig'. Can be repeated or comma-separated.
Font size in points. Can be a non-integer value such as 13.5.
Font variation axis values for variable fonts. Format: 'id=value' where id is a 4-character axis identifier (e.g. wght, slnt).
Font variation axis values for bold text in variable fonts.
Font variation axis values for italic text in variable fonts.
Font variation axis values for bold italic text in variable fonts.
Force specific Unicode codepoints to map to a named font. Syntax: 'U+ABCD=fontname' or 'U+ABCD-U+DEFG=fontname'.
Draw fonts with a thicker stroke, if supported. Currently only supported on macOS.
Strength of font thickening (0-255). Only effective when font-thicken is enabled. macOS only.
Locations to break font shaping into multiple runs. Combine values with a comma; prefix with 'no-' to disable.
Color space for alpha blending of text and transparent images.
Adjust cell width. Values can be integers (1, -1) or percentages (20%, -15%).
Adjust cell height. Values can be integers or percentages. Font is centered vertically; cursor and powerline glyphs are adjusted.
Distance from the bottom of the cell to the text baseline. Increase to move baseline up.
Underline position adjustment from top of cell.
Underline thickness adjustment.
Strikethrough position adjustment.
Strikethrough thickness adjustment.
Overline position adjustment.
Overline thickness adjustment.
Cursor thickness adjustment for bar and outlined rect cursors.
Cursor height adjustment.
Box drawing character thickness adjustment.
Maximum height for nerd font icons. Default is 1.2x the capital letter height.
Method for calculating grapheme cluster cell width.
FreeType load flags for font rendering. Comma-separated list of flags: hinting, force-autohint, monochrome, autohint.
A theme to use. Can be a built-in name, custom name, or absolute path. For light/dark mode: 'light:name,dark:name'. List with 'ghostty +list-themes'.
Window background color. Specified as hex (#RRGGBB or RRGGBB) or a named X11 color.
Window foreground (text) color. Specified as hex (#RRGGBB or RRGGBB) or a named X11 color.
Path to a PNG or JPEG background image for the terminal. Warning: images are duplicated in VRAM per-terminal.
Background image opacity relative to background-opacity.
Position of the background image within the terminal.
How to fit the background image within the terminal.
Whether to tile the background image.
Selection foreground color. Can also be set to 'cell-foreground' or 'cell-background'.
Selection background color. Can also be set to 'cell-foreground' or 'cell-background'.
Clear selection when typing.
Clear selection after copying to clipboard.
Minimum contrast ratio (1-21) between foreground and background. Does not apply to emoji or images.
Color palette (0-255). Syntax: 'N=COLOR' (e.g. '0=#AABBCC'). Can be repeated for multiple palette entries.
Cursor color. Supports hex, X11 color names, 'cell-foreground', or 'cell-background'.
Cursor opacity from 0.0 (fully transparent) to 1.0 (fully opaque).
Default cursor shape.
Default cursor blink state. Leave blank to respect DEC Mode 12.
Color of text under the cursor. Supports hex, X11 names, 'cell-foreground', 'cell-background'.
Move cursor at prompts via Alt+click (Linux) or Option+click (macOS). Requires shell integration.
Color for bold text. Can be a specific color or 'bright' to use bright palette colors.
Opacity of faint text from 0.0 to 1.0.
Hide the mouse cursor while typing. Becomes visible again on mouse movement.
When to scroll to bottom. Comma-separated: 'keystroke' (default: on), 'output' (default: off).
Whether programs can detect shift+click.
Scroll distance multiplier for mouse wheel. Range: 0.01-10000.
Window background opacity from 0.0 (fully transparent) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Requires restart on macOS.
Apply background-opacity to cells with explicit background colors too.
Blur background when background-opacity < 1. Values: 'true' (intensity 20), 'false', or a nonnegative integer. Supported on macOS and some Linux DEs.
Opacity of unfocused splits from 0.15 to 1.0.
Color used for dimming unfocused splits. Defaults to background color.
Color of split dividers. Hex or X11 color name.
The command to run, usually a shell. Supports 'direct:' prefix (no shell expansion) and 'shell:' prefix.
Like 'command' but only applies to the first terminal surface. Also set via the '-e' CLI flag.
Extra environment variables in KEY=VALUE format. Can be repeated. Empty string resets.
Data to send as input on startup. Formats: 'raw:<string>', 'path:<filepath>'. Can be repeated.
Keep terminal open after the command exits until a key is pressed.
Milliseconds of runtime below which an exit is considered abnormal.
Scrollback buffer size in bytes per terminal surface. Oldest lines removed when limit reached.
Match a regex against terminal text and associate it with an action.
Enable URL matching on hover with Ctrl (Linux) / Cmd (macOS).
Show link previews on hover.
Start windows maximized.
Start windows in fullscreen mode.
Force a specific window title, ignoring escape sequences from programs.
Application class/identifier (WM_CLASS on X11, Wayland app ID). GTK only.
Instance name field of WM_CLASS. GTK only.
Starting directory for new terminals.
Horizontal window padding in points. Supports two comma-separated values for asymmetric padding.
Vertical window padding in points. Supports two comma-separated values for asymmetric padding.
Auto-balance extra padding from non-divisible viewport dimensions.
Color of the padding area.
Sync rendering with screen refresh rate. macOS only.
New windows/tabs inherit focused window's working directory.
New windows/tabs inherit focused window's font size.
Window decoration preference.
Font for window and tab titles.
Window subtitle text. GTK only.
Window theme for titlebar and frame. 'ghostty' value is Linux only.
Color space for terminal colors. macOS only.
Initial window height in grid cells. Both window-height and window-width must be set. Minimum: 4.
Initial window width in grid cells. Both window-height and window-width must be set. Minimum: 10.
Starting window X position in pixels. macOS only.
Starting window Y position in pixels. macOS only.
Save and restore window state across app restarts. macOS only.
Resize window in cell-size increments. macOS only.
Where new tabs are created relative to the current tab.
Tab bar visibility. GTK only.
Titlebar background color. Only effective with window-theme=ghostty. GTK only.
Titlebar foreground (text) color. Only effective with window-theme=ghostty. GTK only.
When to show the resize dimensions overlay.
Position of the resize overlay.
How long the resize overlay is visible. Uses time unit syntax (e.g. '750ms', '1s').
Mouse selects the focused split pane automatically.
Allow programs to read the clipboard via OSC 52.
Allow programs to write to the clipboard via OSC 52.
Trim trailing whitespace when copying to clipboard.
Confirm before pasting potentially unsafe text containing newlines.
Treat pastes in bracketed paste mode as safe.
Enable title reporting via CSI 21 t. Warning: can expose sensitive information.
Max bytes for image data per terminal screen. Set to 0 to disable image protocols.
Auto-copy selected text to clipboard.
Action on right-click.
Milliseconds between clicks for multi-click detection.
Additional config files to load. Supports '?' prefix for optional files. Cycles are not allowed.
Load default configuration file paths. CLI-only setting.
Confirm before closing terminal surfaces.
Quit the application when the last window is closed.
Delay before quitting after the last window closes. Minimum: 1s. Linux only.
Create an initial window on application launch.
Duration that undo operations remain available. macOS only.
Position of the quick (Quake-style) terminal.
Size as percentage or pixels. Two comma-separated values for both axes.
Wayland layer for the quick terminal. GTK Wayland only.
Wayland namespace identifier for the quick terminal. GTK Wayland only.
Which screen the quick terminal appears on. macOS only.
Animation duration in seconds. Set to 0 to disable animation. macOS only.
Auto-hide the quick terminal on focus loss.
Behavior when switching macOS spaces. macOS only.
Keyboard input behavior for the quick terminal. Wayland only.
Shell integration auto-injection mode.
Shell integration features to enable. Comma-separated, prefix with 'no-' to disable.
Custom command palette entries. Format: 'title:Name, action:action_name'.
Format for OSC color query responses.
Allow KAM mode (ANSI mode 2) which locks keyboard input.
Path to a GLSL custom shader file. Shadertoy-compatible. Can be repeated for multiple shaders.
Animation loop behavior for custom shaders.
Bell features to enable. Comma-separated: system, audio, attention, title, border.
Path to audio file for the terminal bell. GTK only.
Bell audio volume from 0.0 to 1.0. GTK only.
Control in-app notification display. Prefix with 'no-' to disable. GTK only.
Allow programs to show desktop notifications via OSC 9 and OSC 777.
Value for the TERM environment variable.
String to send in response to ENQ (0x05).
Low-level async I/O backend. Linux only.
Non-native fullscreen mode. Note: tabs do NOT work in non-native fullscreen.
Traffic light button visibility.
Window titlebar style.
Proxy icon visibility in the titlebar.
Behavior when dropping files on the dock icon.
Treat the Option key as Alt for keybindings.
Show window shadow.
Hide Ghostty from the dock and app switcher.
Automatically enable secure input at password prompts.
Show graphical indication when secure input is enabled.
Customize the app icon appearance.
Path to a custom icon file (PNG, JPEG, ICNS).
Icon frame material for the app icon.
Ghost color in the app icon. Required for custom-style.
Screen gradient color(s) in the app icon. Up to 64 comma-separated colors. Required for custom-style.
Allow macOS Shortcuts to control Ghostty.
Auto-update behavior. macOS only.
Release channel for auto-updates. macOS only.
Cgroup isolation per terminal surface.
Memory limit per terminal process in bytes. Sets cgroup memory.high (soft limit).
Process count limit per terminal. Sets cgroup pids.max (hard limit).
Fail on cgroup initialization errors instead of continuing.
Enable OpenGL debug logging. GTK only.
Single-instance application mode. GTK only.
Show the full GTK titlebar. No effect when window-decoration is false. GTK only.
Tab bar position. GTK only.
Hide the titlebar when the window is maximized. GTK only.
Top/bottom bar appearance style. GTK only.
GTK titlebar style. GTK only.
Use wide tabs (Gnome-style). GTK only.
Custom CSS files to load. Supports '?' prefix for optional files. Max 5MiB per file. GTK only.

actions.description: Ignore this key combination. Ghostty will not process it or forward it to the terminal.
Unbind a previously bound key binding.
Send a CSI sequence. Value is the sequence without the CSI header (ESC [ or \x1b[).
Send an ESC sequence.
Send the specified text using Zig string literal syntax.
Send data depending on whether cursor key mode is enabled (application) or disabled (normal).
Reset the terminal, equivalent to running the 'reset' command.
Copy the selected text to the clipboard.
Paste contents of the default clipboard.
Paste contents of the selection clipboard.
Copy the URL under the cursor to the clipboard, if any.
Copy the terminal title to the clipboard.
Increase font size by the specified amount in points.
Decrease font size by the specified amount in points.
Reset font size to the original configured size.
Set font size to the specified size in points.
Clear the screen and all scrollback.
Select all text on the screen.
Scroll to the top of the scrollback.
Scroll to the bottom of the screen.
Scroll to the selected text.
Scroll the screen up by one page.
Scroll the screen down by one page.
Scroll by a fraction of a page. Positive scrolls down, negative scrolls up.
Scroll by a number of lines. Positive scrolls down, negative scrolls up.
Adjust the current selection in a direction. Does nothing without an active selection.
Jump the viewport by the given number of prompts. Requires shell integration.
Write the entire scrollback to a temporary file and perform the specified action.
Write screen contents to a temporary file and perform the specified action.
Write selected text to a temporary file and perform the specified action.
Open a new window. Brings the application to the front if not focused.
Open a new tab.
Go to the previous tab.
Go to the next tab.
Go to the last tab.
Go to the tab with the given index (starting from 1).
Move the current tab by a relative offset. Wraps around cyclically.
Toggle the tab overview. Requires libadwaita 1.4+ on Linux.
Change the title of the focused surface via a pop-up prompt.
Create a new split in the specified direction.
Focus on a split in the specified direction or order.
Zoom in or out of the current split.
Resize the current split. Format: 'direction,pixels' (e.g. 'up,10').
Equalize the size of all splits in the current window.
Reset the window to its default size. macOS only.
Control the terminal inspector visibility.
Show the GTK inspector. Linux/GTK only.
Show the on-screen keyboard. Linux/GTK only.
Open the configuration file in the default OS editor.
Reload the configuration. Re-reads config file and applies changes.
Close the current surface (window, tab, or split). May trigger confirmation.
Close the current tab and all splits, or close other tabs depending on mode.
Close the current window and all tabs/splits. May trigger confirmation.
Close all windows. Deprecated: use 'all:close_window' instead.
Maximize or unmaximize the current window. No effect on macOS.
Toggle fullscreen for the current window.
Toggle window decorations (titlebar, buttons). Linux only.
Toggle whether the window always floats on top. macOS only.
Toggle secure input mode to prevent keyboard monitoring. macOS only.
Toggle the command palette. Requires libadwaita 1.5+ on Linux.
Toggle the quick (Quake-style) terminal. Best used with global keybinds.
Show or hide all windows. macOS only.
Check for application updates. macOS only.
Undo the last undoable action (close window/tab/split). Time-limited by undo-timeout. macOS only.
Redo the last undone action.
Quit Ghostty.
Crash Ghostty in the specified thread for testing crash handling.
